sendNotificationEmail.assessment: The pinned RM2PT operation is an abstract third-party service contract: it requires only a nonempty email value and a true result. The V2 input deliberately does not claim message construction, actual delivery, failure handling or an externally observable side effect, because none is specified.

updates.difficulty_basis: One scalar input guard and one constant Boolean result in an explicitly abstract external-service stub.
updates.effects_audit: Only the nonempty-input guard and true result are part of this benchmark operation. No email-delivery effect is asserted or inferred.
